## Bio
Matthew is a current student at Johns Hopkins University's Bloomberg School of Public Health studying in the Molecular Microbiology and Immunology department. His research insterests include computational and structural modeling of host/pathogen interactions, in-vitro mechanistic studies of host/pathogen interactions and pathways, and understanding the metabolic impacts of viral infections on the host. Outside of lab, he is an active participant in two choirs: [The New Wave Singers](https://newwavesingers.org) of Baltimore & [Mosaic Community Chorus](https://mosaiccommunitychorus.square.site/about). He likes playing sandbox and idle games, and also enjoys using his hands for baking, crocheting, and other creative activities.
